Presenting a very special episode of The Slow Cafe with Neelesh Misra
This Slow Interview is a little different from others because of the uniqueness of the guest.
Meet Naezy in this episode of The Slow Interview.
About Naezy:
He has tasted success at an early age but rapper Naezy is afraid of handling fame. “Ran after fame once, now I run away from it,” the ‘Mere Gully Mein’ singer says in The Slow Interview with Neelesh Misra.
